responsibility: Defines the internal data structures and visitor framework behind Rust TyTy variance analysis. It introduces the private constraint language used to solve variances for generic ADTs (Term, Constraint, and solution indices), the per-crate solver state that stores variance solutions and maps type references to solution slots, and the TyTy visitor-based contexts that traverse types, regions, generic arguments, and fields to either accumulate variance constraints, collect variances/regions from concrete types, or map field regions back to parent ADT regions.
